rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent low, stepped hall-like mass across all four views, so the silhouette and repair integrity are acceptable. However, the visible geometry is still overly boxy and segmented, with weak dominance of a single long-span hall idea and little evidence of the section logic expected for a gymnasium. The thick blue access edge is not answered by a meaningful public void, entry seam, or undercut; instead the mass remains largely sealed and semantically indifferent to the frontage. The stepped roof language is not yet carrying a convincing span/daylight narrative and risks reading as arbitrary tiering rather than gym section. Because the program contract requires a legible long-span hall with subordinate support and an active public threshold, the current form fails program_fit_hard_pass even though it is geometrically stable.

Clear hall/bar hierarchy with an open, legible frontage and differentiated roof depth.
